mapper.sql: select l.library_id, l.library_name, l.library_code, l.category, l.tag_object, l.dataset_id, l.owner_name, l.status, l.last_sync_version_id, l.last_sync_time, l.del_flag, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.remark, ds.dataset_name from tl_tag_library l left join dp_dataset ds on ds.dataset_id = l.dataset_id
mapper.select: select l.library_id, l.library_name, l.library_code, l.category, l.tag_object, l.dataset_id, l.owner_name, l.status, l.last_sync_version_id, l.last_sync_time, l.del_flag, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.remark from tl_tag_library l where l.library_id = #{libraryId} and l.del_flag = '0' for update
mapper.update: update tl_tag_library set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where library_id = #{id}
mapper.select: select d.dataset_id as datasetId, d.dataset_code as datasetCode, d.dataset_name as datasetName from dp_dataset d join dp_dataset_version v on v.version_id = d.default_version_id and v.version_status = 'ONLINE' where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' order by d.dataset_id
mapper.update: update tl_tag_library set last_sync_version_id = #{versionId}, last_sync_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where library_id = #{libraryId}
